**sdd/issue-887-lane-collector/proposal**

**What**: Proposal for #887 (memory 2.0 task 3.1a) — the lane collector: `brain/scripts/memory/lane/{plan.mjs,collect.mjs}` + a `collect` op on `memory/cli.mjs` that reads every worktree of the clone via git plumbing and produces ONE LOCAL ref `refs/heads/memory/<host>-<date>`. No push, no PR, no hook.

**Why**: ADR-0034 (L4 + C2) ruled the memory lane; nothing builds it yet. Today `hooks/pre-push:70` runs `cli.mjs share` on every push, exporting the whole backend into whatever tree pushes — the same untracked record sits in up to 7 of this clone's 82 worktrees. learn->main is p50 21.6h / p90 399.7h.

**Where**: `/home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-887/openspec/changes/issue-887-lane-collector/proposal.md` (frontmatter `status: proposed`, `issue: 887`, `epic: 864`).

**Decisions (D1-D7)**:
- D1 — `collect` op on `memory/cli.mjs`, dispatched BEFORE backend selection beside reindex/audit/resolve-index/split-records (backend-agnostic). `npm run memory:collect`. No collision with #888's `brain:memory:ship`, which will CALL collect. Failure convention is reindex's (own try/catch + `memory.collect.done|failed` i18n + exit 0/1), NOT the VCS port's never-throws/`unsupportedOp` — that path is unreachable here. Output `{ ref, commit, collected, skipped, duplicates }`; NO top-level `divergent`, because `lib/duplicates.mjs`'s accounting already carries `{ids,lines,divergent,groups}` and reusing it makes `reportDuplicates` print C2's report for free.
- D2 — Same-day re-run APPENDS a commit onto the existing ref (parent = ref tip, tree = read-tree(ref tip) + new blobs), never a `-<n>` suffix (that suffix is for cross-host same-day name collisions). Zero candidates -> `{commit: null, collected: 0}`. Residual: the appended tree descends from main-at-first-run, so #889's `lane-paths` MUST compute paths three-dot (merge-base) or main's concurrent additions read as deletions. Remote lane ref is out of scope — collector fetches `origin main` only and touches the local ref only.
- D3 — Divergent same-named copies: lexicographic worktree path, then physical line (ADR-0034 C2's ratified tiebreak). Post-#677 a file IS one record, so the reader's "earliest month file, earliest line" degenerates to "line 1 of both" — hence the added tiebreak. Rejected: content-hash-smallest (equally arbitrary, not ratified), mtime (not reproducible). Proof obligation is STABILITY: shuffled enumeration order must yield a deeply-equal plan, not just a correct single run.
- D4 — Secret scrub: skip THAT candidate (`skipped: {reason:'secret', pattern, lineNumber}`) and collect the rest, scanning BEFORE `hash-object -w`. Deviates from `engram.mjs:394-407`'s abort-the-batch throw because one poisoned record would otherwise deny the whole lane on an unattended host, and because `hash-object -w` is a durable write only `gc --prune` can undo. `lane-scrub` (#889, C1) stays the all-or-nothing PR gate. Never print `hit.line` — it IS the secret; only `pattern` + `lineNumber`, exactly as `share` does.
- D5 — Candidates: untracked (`??`) `.memory/records/*.jsonl`, absent from `origin/main`, `validateRecord` ok. Skips: `already-on-main`, `modified-tracked` (a modification is not a lane per L1; that's #805's `supersedes` path), `invalid`, `unreadable`. `.memory/index.jsonl` never a candidate (L3). Main checkout is just another worktree; `prunable`/`bare` skipped; `locked` included; NEVER `worktree prune`. Use ONE `git ls-tree -r origin/main -- .memory/records` per run instead of one `cat-file -e` per candidate.
- D6 — Pure `planLaneCommit({worktrees, candidates, onMain, host, date, parent})` -> `{files, duplicates, skipped, message}`; IO shell with an injected `gitTry`/`gitOrThrow` seam shaped like `governance/postmerge/git-seam.mjs:27,54` (distinct from `vcs/lib/exec.mjs`). Temp index via `GIT_INDEX_FILE` in a mkdtemp, removed in `finally`. Invariant: no working tree or repo index touched — proven by snapshotting `git status --porcelain` in both scratch worktrees before/after. Ambient git author identity, never a token, never fabricated. Offline: fall back to local `origin/main`, report `baseFetched:false`.
- D7 — In: plan/collect/cli op/i18n/package.json + 2 test files. Out: push and PR incl. `--no-verify` (#888), `brain:memory:ship` and hook wiring (#888/L5), `lane-paths`/`lane-scrub` (#889), retiring `pre-push:70` (#890). No `brain/core/**` write and no `brain-drafts/` — verified no drift guard reads `memory-format.md`/`memory-backend-contract.md` the way `verb-contract-drift-guard.test.mjs` reads `vcs-contract.md`, so unlike #886 this PR needs no maintainer promotion sitting.

**Delivery**: STRICT TDD — `lane/plan.test.mjs` (pure) then `lane/collect.integration.test.mjs` (real temp repo + two real `git worktree add` trees). ~330 counted lines (Medium), ~730 reviewer-visible. One PR recommended, with a pre-agreed split at the planner seam (PR1 pure planner, PR2 shell + CLI) if the shell overruns. `ask-on-risk`.

**Learned**:
- `scanTextForSecrets` (`secret-scrub.mjs:87`) returns `{pattern, lineNumber, line}` and `line` is the matched text — printing it leaks the secret. `share` interpolates only `lineNumber`+`pattern` (`engram.mjs:402-405`); every new consumer must do the same.
- `lib/duplicates.mjs` accounting already has a `divergent` COUNT; adding a sibling top-level field would be a second source of truth.
- No code in `brain/scripts/**` reads `git worktree list` today — every existing use is add/remove/prune. This is the first consumer of worktree enumeration as a data source.
- 4 open questions raised for the maintainer (scrub granularity vs `share`'s precedent; whether `modified-tracked` should exit non-zero; whether depending on #889's three-dot diff is acceptable; single PR vs split) — none blocking spec/design.
